editorial.meta_description: The ACP-610 exam is retired as of 2025-09-11. Review verified details and focus your preparation on the ACP-620 successor exam path.
editorial.overview: The Atlassian Certified Project Administrator for Jira Cloud exam was a formal certification administered by Atlassian that evaluated candidate knowledge across five distinct domains with a total of 75 questions. Because this exam officially retired on 2025-09-11, candidates should instead direct their preparation toward the verified successor exam, ACP-620, which represents the designated path forward.
editorial.who_should_take: Project administrators and Jira practitioners aiming to demonstrate cloud project configuration skills. Because this credential is retired, candidates must register for the active successor certification instead.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Preparation strategies should target the ACP-620 successor exam rather than attempting to study for this retired test. Although core knowledge of Jira Cloud configuration, workflows, and board management transfers directly, candidates must review current cloud documentation to learn fresh features and updated interface patterns before testing.

domain_guidance.summary: This specific domain carefully covers project creation procedures, various project types, and basic project configuration settings that are required within the Jira Cloud environment for effective administrative work.

This domain focuses broadly on board creation processes, backlog organization techniques, and agile tool management designed specifically to support Scrum and Kanban teams during their daily operational tasks.

This particular domain addresses advanced workflow design principles, status transitions, conditional rules, and dependable automation configuration strategies tailored specifically for modern cloud-based projects running inside the platform environment today.

This domain centers entirely on managing user access levels, assigned project roles, detailed permission schemes, and customized notification settings intended to maintain secure and functional project environments overall.

This specific domain explores building informative dashboards, generating analytical reports, and configuring specific widgets to successfully track and communicate ongoing team progress across various administrative projects found within the system.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Because this particular examination is retired, it cannot be scheduled anymore. Candidates testing for the successor certification must complete the proctored exam online or in person.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: During its active lifecycle, the examination consisted of a total of 75 multiple choice and multiple select questions designed to carefully evaluate candidate knowledge across all five distinct domains.
Candidates were required to achieve a minimum passing score of 70 in order to successfully pass the examination and earn the designated credential from Atlassian during its active period.
The active examination had an allocated total duration of 120 minutes, giving all registered candidates adequate time to complete every assigned question within the testing session successfully.

faq.question_title: What is the price of the exam?
faq.answer_text: The standard registration price for taking the examination was established at $250 USD for all eligible participating candidates who registered through the official platform during its operational lifecycle.
